common_reasoner_instruction: Use only the supplied project evidence, candidate action menu, and any supplied methodological context for project-specific claims. General reasoning is allowed, but do not invent hidden project facts. Treat unknown project context as unknown rather than false. Classify every candidate action exactly once using one of BLOCKING_REQUIRED, RECOMMENDED, DEFER, or NOT_NOW. BLOCKING_REQUIRED is not merely a stronger recommendation: use it only when the project evidence and methodological reasoning imply that a named downstream scope cannot yet be defended. Return only blocked scopes from the supplied scope menu and required clarification IDs from the supplied clarification menu. In methodological_basis, list only supplied stable keys that materially support the result; for a condition with no supplied methodological assets, methodological_basis must be empty. Do not infer recommendation strength solely from selection_reason metadata.

deterministic_metric_definitions.exact_disposition_accuracy: fraction of candidate actions whose predicted disposition exactly equals expected_disposition
deterministic_metric_definitions.critical_action_omission: expected BLOCKING_REQUIRED action predicted as any other disposition
deterministic_metric_definitions.under_recommendation: expected RECOMMENDED action predicted as DEFER or NOT_NOW
deterministic_metric_definitions.over_recommendation: expected DEFER or NOT_NOW action predicted as RECOMMENDED or BLOCKING_REQUIRED
deterministic_metric_definitions.unnecessary_recommended_cost: sum(cost_units) for actions expected DEFER or NOT_NOW but predicted RECOMMENDED or BLOCKING_REQUIRED
deterministic_metric_definitions.blocking_scope_false_negative: expected blocked scope absent from predicted blocked_scopes
deterministic_metric_definitions.blocking_scope_false_positive: predicted blocked scope absent from expected_blocked_scopes
deterministic_metric_definitions.required_clarification_false_negative: expected required clarification absent from required_clarification_ids
deterministic_metric_definitions.unsupported_methodological_basis: methodological_basis key not supplied in the current condition
